messages:
megan: quick heads-up — found a couple orphan links in the handbook TOC while prepping release notes. flags: /handbook/dedicated-deploy -> 404 and the runtime FAQ image path is 403. can someone own a quick triage? :mag:
ashok: i can take the infra link. do we have the canonical destination? is it the old runbook page or a new guide?
megan: it's the old 'dedicated-deploy' page that got moved during the nav refactor. i started a stub PR but didn't finish the redirects. not urgent but want it fixed before the docs sweep tomorrow.
jamie: i'll grab the broken image. which key is it?
megan: screenshot path: s3://kb-assets/screens/serve-req-403.png — rehost to the CDN and update the mdx path. also please add alt text.
linda: small ops ask — can we put a codeowner/frontmatter owner so this notifies the handbook folks automatically next time?
megan: totally. if one of you adds `owners: team:docs-eng` to the frontmatter i'll treat that as done. cc @ashok @jamie for CR.
ashok: quick patch i'll push to fix the redirect and the internal links. diff i'll apply: 
```
- /handbook/dedicated-deploy
+ /handbook/dedicated-deploy/index.md
```
jamie: rehost done — uploaded new asset to CDN, resized to 800px. updated the mdx reference in my PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/988 and added alt text \"404 repro: client-facing error\".
deploy-bot: build started for branch docs/orphan-link-fix — build 3124 (status: queued)
megan: awesome. once both PRs pass CI can someone merge? want this in tomorrow's sweep.
linda: will merge after CI + i'll add the frontmatter owner line `owners: [@docs-eng]` in the handbook index.
ashok: CI green for my PR, merged PR #987. :tada:
jamie: my PR 988 is also green, left one tiny nit and then merged.
megan: thank you — leaving a short changelog note in the handbook.
jamie: also added a one-line note in the runbook about canonical link patterns to avoid future drift.
megan: great. closing this thread — ping me if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
